Scope & Coordination

Plan the room behind the finishes

A bathroom renovation is more than tile and fixtures. Substrate condition, waterproofing, drainage, ventilation, electrical protection, plumbing locations, clearances, and product specifications all affect how the room performs.

J&N StructureWorks coordinates the contracted demolition, trade work, inspections, installation, and finishes from a written scope. Layout changes and concealed conditions are evaluated before final pricing whenever access and available information allow.

Services may include

  • Existing-condition and layout review
  • Selective demolition and site protection
  • Shower, tub and waterproofing coordination
  • Plumbing, electrical and ventilation work
  • Vanities, tile, fixtures, accessories and paint
  • Permit and inspection coordination for the contracted scope

Project Process

From site review to final walkthrough

01

Assess

Review the existing room, moisture concerns, accessibility goals, layout, photos, and available plans.

02

Specify

Define the scope, products, waterproofing approach, allowances, permits, and sequencing.

03

Construct

Coordinate demolition, rough-ins, substrates, inspections, tile, fixtures, and finishes.

04

Verify

Complete functional checks, punch work, final inspections when required, and turnover.
